title: Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging: A Semantic Superposition and Contextual Lamination Framework for Malpractice-Resilient Online Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.13100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contemporary online assessment systems rely primarily on browser lockdown, webcam monitoring, and behavioural analytics, yet remain vulnerable to attacks that extract the assessment content itself through screenshots, screen sharing, optical character recognition, and automated scraping. This paper extends the Multi-dimensional Spatio-Temporal Context Camouflaging Model (MSCCM) within the MARS (Multi-modal Assessment Resilience Suite) by introducing the Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging Theory (MCCT), a mathematical framework that protects rendered assessment content through semantic superposition. Authentic assessment content and synthetically generated camouflage are represented as a unified rendering while remaining recoverable only by legitimate candidates. The framework models the adversarial extraction process through an explicit extraction-channel operator and develops six coupled constructs: the Context Inversion Operator, Context

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13100v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当代在线评估系统主要依赖浏览器锁定、摄像头监控和行为分析，但仍易受到通过截图、屏幕共享、光学字符识别和自动抓取等方式提取评估内容本身的攻击。本文在多模态评估韧性套件（MARS）中扩展了多维时空上下文伪装模型（MSCCM），引入了多层上下文伪装理论（MCCT），这是一种通过语义叠加保护渲染评估内容的数学框架。真实评估内容和合成生成的伪装被表示为统一的渲染结果，同时仅对合法考生可恢复。该框架通过显式提取通道算子对对抗性提取过程进行建模，并开发了六个耦合结构：上下文反演算子、上下文
tldr: 本文提出了一种多层上下文伪装理论，通过语义叠加技术将真实评估内容与合成伪装统一渲染，仅允许合法考生恢复，从而有效抵御截图、屏幕共享等对抗性内容提取攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging Theory that protects online assessment content via semantic superposition, rendering authentic and synthetic content uniformly while ensuring recoverability only by legitimate candidates, thereby resisting adversarial extraction attacks.
